User.title: User
User.description: Represents a user of the BriqueBoost application.

id.description: Unique identifier for the user (matches auth.uid).

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the user account was created.

aiUsageCount.description: The number of times the user has used an AI feature in the current billing cycle.

aiUsageLastReset.description: Timestamp indicating when the AI usage count was last reset.

totalProfit.description: The total net profit, calculated from sales minus purchase prices and other costs.

totalRevenue.description: The total gross revenue from all sold items.

totalInvestment.description: The total purchase price of all acquired items.

totalItemsSold.description: The total number of items sold.

itemsInStock.description: The total number of items currently in stock.

totalInvestmentSold.description: The total purchase price of all sold items.

totalOtherCosts.description: The total of other miscellaneous costs.

itemsInStockNew.description: Count of items in stock with 'New' condition.

itemsInStockUsedLikeNew.description: Count of items in stock with 'Used - Like New' condition.

itemsInStockUsedGood.description: Count of items in stock with 'Used - Good' condition.

itemsInStockUsedFair.description: Count of items in stock with 'Used - Fair' condition.

itemsInStockForParts.description: Count of items in stock with 'For Parts' condition.

accountStatus.description: The activation status of the user's account.

activatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the user account was activated.

expiresAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the user's access expires.

Item.title: Item
Item.description: Represents a denormalized item, including its listing and sale details.

userId.description: Reference to the User who owns this item.

name.description: A short, descriptive name for the item.

purchasePrice.description: The price the user paid for the item.

purchaseDate.description: The date the user purchased the item.

condition.description: The condition of the item when purchased.

source.description: The source from which the item was purchased.

initialTitle.description: The user's initial title for the listing.

initialDescription.description: The user's initial description for the listing.

status.description: The current status of the listing.

enhancedTitle.description: The AI-enhanced title for the listing.

enhancedDescription.description: The AI-enhanced description for the listing.

reasoning.description: The AI's reasoning for the enhancements.

platform.description: The sales platform the item is listed on.

salePrice.description: The price at which the item was sold.

saleDate.description: The date the item was sold.

profit.description: The profit made from the sale of the item.

WishlistItem.title: Wishlist Item
WishlistItem.description: Represents an item a customer has expressed interest in.

id.description: Unique identifier for the wishlist item.

userId.description: Reference to the User who owns this item.

itemName.description: The name or description of the desired item.

customerNotes.description: Notes about the customer or the specific request.

status.description: The current status of the wishlist item.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the wishlist item was created.

MonthlySummary.title: Monthly Summary
MonthlySummary.description: Represents a monthly summary of sales activity for a user.

id.description: Unique identifier for the summary in 'YYYY-MM' format.

totalProfit.description: Total net profit for the month.

totalItemsSold.description: Total items sold during the month.

totalRevenue.description: Total gross revenue for the month.

totalInvestment.description: Total investment (purchase price) for items added this month.

totalInvestmentSold.description: Total purchase price of items sold this month.

totalOtherCosts.description: Total other costs for the month.

ActivationCode.title: Activation Code
ActivationCode.description: Represents a redeemable code that grants a user access for a specific duration.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the code was created.

durationInMonths.description: The number of months of access this code grants upon activation.

isUsed.description: Whether this code has already been redeemed.

usedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the code was redeemed.

usedBy.description: UID of the user who redeemed the code.

OtherCost.title: Other Cost
OtherCost.description: Represents other costs associated with acquiring items, such as transport, tolls, etc.

userId.description: Reference to the User who incurred this cost.

date.description: The date the cost was incurred.

firestore.reasoning: The Firestore structure is simplified to use a denormalized 'items' collection under each user's private path. This aligns with the application's component structure and simplifies data fetching by avoiding client-side joins. The primary collections are `/users/{userId}` for user profiles and `/users/{userId}/items/{itemId}` for all item-related data, including listing and sale information. This path-based ownership model is secure and allows for straightforward security rules that enforce user data isolation effectively.
